steps.journalDescription: Now that I have raised the camp's alarm, Kastor will not help me without allies. Perhaps if I defeat the guards that have locked down the north eastern section of the camp, the branded there will join the fight. I should gather others to help me, it will surely be a tough fight.
The Branded have joined the fight. Now the riots can commence. I should return to Kastor to see if he will join us as well.

steps.stepName: The Branded will not help me.
steps.journalDescription: The Branded want no part of what I have started. I have failed to convince them to join me.
Kastor has finally come around to fighting the guards.
